rules.breakout: price at least 10% above its level 24 to 32 days earlier and above the highest price of the prior 26 weeks, first week only
rules.decline: price 15% or more below its level 24 to 32 days earlier
rules.entry: cheapest landed price today among Card Kingdom retail, TCGplayer listed median and eBay asks, each seen within 3 days; TCGplayer market is never an entry price
rules.store_gap: landed price at one store 15% or more below the lowest landed price elsewhere, both seen within 3 days; gaps wider than 60% are dropped as data errors
rules.buy_breakout: buy when the 13-week margin is above zero: the landed entry price sits less than the historical 13-week median breakout return above the TCGplayer market price; otherwise no_buy
rules.buy_store_gap: buy when the cheaper store's landed price is at least 10% below a TCGplayer market price seen within 3 days; otherwise no_buy. A default threshold with no historical test
rules.fell_recently: 4-week change of -10% or less, or 1-week change of -8% or less (nearest observations 24 to 32 and 5 to 9 days back); sorted by 4-week change, most negative first
rules.far_below_high: price 20% or more below the highest price of the prior 26 weeks (at least 13 observed); sorted by drawdown, deepest first
rules.buy_faller: buy only when the landed entry price is at least 10% below the TCGplayer market price seen within 3 days, the same untested rule as store gaps; otherwise watch. A fall alone is never a buy
rules.near: NEAR when a row is not a buy but its landed entry price is at or below the TCGplayer market price (within 10% of the buy level) for fallers and store gaps, or its 13-week margin is between -5 points and 0 for breakouts; WATCH otherwise. A default band, not backtested
rules.expectation: median 52-week change of comparable products (category, age, state) in the TCGplayer weekly archive, applied to the market price; a historical base rate, not a forecast, and it changes no signal
rules.fund_move: one-week move of 10% or more in a product the fund holds, information only

calibration.method: Weekly TCGplayer market price (tcgcsv archive, Mondays) for in-scope products with at least 40 weekly observations at 20 dollars or more. Excess = forward log return minus the same-date median across the sample. Breakout: 4-week rise of 10% or more and above the previous 26 weeks' high. Decline: 4-week drop of 15% or more. Added: 4-week drop of 10% or more; 1-week drop of 8% or more; 20% or more below the previous 26 weeks' high (at least 13 observed). all_products_median_raw_pct is the median raw forward return of every eligible product-week.

forward_52w.note: Distinct start dates with a 52-week forward observation: the archive begins in February 2024, so this is little more than one independent year of outcomes. Product-weeks overlap heavily. A historical base rate, not a forecast.

definitions.far_below_high: 20 percent or more below the highest of the previous 26 weeks (at least 13 observed)
definitions.breakout: 4-week rise of 10 percent or more and above the previous 26 weeks' high
definitions.age: years since set release at the start date: under_1y, 1_to_3y, over_3y, unknown
definitions.fallback: a cell with fewer than 30 distinct products falls back to category x age, then category, then all products
